meta.description: Fired by the HRIS the moment a one-off Urgent Payment is filed from the People tab (POST /api/people/pay) and lands in Payment Dispatch → Urgent. Acks immediately, then emails carla@simple.biz, claire@simple.biz and lennyt@simple.biz a red-alarm alert (who / amount / dept / note / filed-by + a button to the HRIS) so they dispatch it. Recipients + copy are fixed inside Build Alert Emails — the caller only supplies the request details. Attach a Gmail OAuth2 credential to the send node before activating; register the production URL under Admin → Webhooks slug `urgent_payment_notify` (or env N8N_URGENT_PAYMENT_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL); optionally set REQUIRED_SECRET here + N8N_URGENT_PAYMENT_NOTIFY_SECRET in the HRIS to lock the webhook.
